observations.observation: At 09:32 ET (13:32Z) on October 5, Research and Markets announced that its Quantum Technology Market Report 2026 had been added to its offering. The release gives market-wide 2025 and 2026 figures and a 2030 forecast, and names Intel among the report's companies.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: These are report estimates/forecasts, not realized Intel results. The release gives no Intel-specific order, product, customer, deployment, or financial event.

observations.observation: A Yahoo Finance copy carries the same release headline and 09:32 ET timestamp; the supplied feed snapshot was collected before cutoff.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: This is syndication of the same Research and Markets release, not independent reporting. Live page opening was rate-limited.

observations.observation: At 09:33 ET (13:33Z), Research and Markets issued a separate release for a 'Quantum Computing and Technologies' market with different 2026 and 2030 estimates; Intel also appears in that report's company list.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: It is a separate report by the same source with a different stated market scope, so the different values are not a like-for-like revision or direct contradiction.

observations.observation: Current R&M and The Business Research Company catalog pages label the underlying report February 2026 and September 2026, respectively, while showing the same broad estimates.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: Both catalog pages were accessed after cutoff without dated pre-cutoff snapshots; the displayed month discrepancy does not resolve when the report's figures first became public.

gaps: No independent contemporaneous editorial report was located in the focused search. Yahoo and other surfaced copies reproduce the press release; the official report-publisher catalog is not an independent news account.

The underlying report's exact first-publication date and as-of-cutoff catalog text remain unverified because the current distributor and publisher pages conflict on publication month and lack dated pre-cutoff snapshots.
The public release does not provide enough methodology or source detail to independently validate the forecast assumptions; the full underlying report was not reviewed.
research_notes: Cutoff: 2026-10-05T13:46:44.129567Z.
